1.title: Exam Technique and Final Review
1.text: Welcome to Module twenty-five: Exam Technique and Final Review. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do four things. The pairs the exam likes to confuse. Numbers and ports to know cold. The troubleshooting order. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: All domains. Exam format: up to ninety questions in ninety minutes; a score of seven hundred twenty on a scale of one hundred to nine hundred passes. Validated against: the official Comp T I A Network plus N ten to nine exam objectives, version four point zero.

1.title: The pairs the exam likes to confuse
1.text: The pairs the exam likes to confuse. I D S or I P S. alerts or blocks inline. N A S or S A N. file-level or block-level. Scalability or elasticity. can grow or grows and shrinks automatically. T C P or U D P. reliable or fast and unreliable. A H or E S P. authentication only or encryption too. R A D I U S or T A C A C S plus. network access, U D P or device administration, T C P, full encryption. Site-to-site or client-to-site V P N (virtual private network). office to office or user to office. Full or split tunnel. all traffic in the V P N or only company traffic. R P O or R T O. acceptable data loss or acceptable downtime. Cold or warm or hot site. shell or equipment, old data or running, current data.

1.title: The pairs the exam likes to confuse, continued
1.text: The pairs the exam likes to confuse. Active-active or active-passive. shared load or standby takes over. E O L or E O S. no longer sold or no longer supported. Flow data or packet capture. summaries or full contents. S N M P version two C or S N M P version three. community strings or authentication and encryption. D N S S E C or Do H. proves authenticity or hides the query. Bandwidth or throughput. capacity or data actually delivered. Latency or jitter. delay or variation in delay.

1.title: Numbers and ports to know cold
1.text: Numbers and ports to know cold. Ports. S S H twenty-two, Telnet twenty-three, S M T P twenty-five, D N S fifty-three, D H C P sixty-seven or sixty-eight, H T T P eighty, N T P one hundred twenty-three, S N M P one hundred sixty-one or one hundred sixty-two, L D A P (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) three hundred eighty-nine, H T T P S four hundred forty-three, S M B (Server Message Block) four hundred forty-five, R D P three thousand three hundred eighty-nine. Private ranges. ten or eight, one hundred seventy-two point one six or twelve, one hundred ninety-two point one six eight or sixteen; A P I P A one hundred sixty-nine point two five four or sixteen. Subnets. slash twenty-four two hundred fifty-four, slash twenty-five one hundred twenty-six, slash twenty-six sixty-two, slash twenty-seven thirty, slash twenty-eight fourteen, slash twenty-nine six, slash thirty two. Channels at two point four gigahertz. one, six, eleven. Administrative distance. static one, E I G R P ninety, O S P F one hundred ten, R I P one hundred twenty. M T U. one thousand five hundred standard, about nine thousand jumbo.

1.title: The troubleshooting order
1.text: The troubleshooting order. Identify, theory, test, plan, implement, verify, document. Exam tip: In a scenario, find the layer first (cable and link lights, switch and V L A N, I P and routing, transport and ports, application and D N S), then match the symptom to the tool or fix. Exam tip: Performance-based questions are scored. Read the whole task, do what is asked and nothing more, and check your work before moving on.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Which protocol encrypts remote administration of a switch on port twenty-two? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: S S H. S S H uses port twenty-two.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. How many usable hosts does a slash twenty-seven subnet provide? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: thirty. A slash twenty-seven has thirty-two addresses and thirty usable hosts.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A company can lose at most four hours of data. Which metric states this? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: R P O of four hours. R P O is the acceptable data loss in time.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. A host with a one sixty-nine dot two fifty-four dot x dot x address cannot reach the network. What is the most likely cause? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: D H C P did not assign an address. A P I P A addresses appear when D H C P fails.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. Which first step does the troubleshooting methodology start with? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Identify the problem. Gathering information about the problem comes first.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Which device alerts on suspicious traffic but does not block it? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: An intrusion detection system. An I D S alerts; an I P S blocks.

1.title: Practice Question 7
1.text: Question seven. Which command shows the routing table on a network device? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: show route. show route displays the routing table.

1.title: Practice Question 8
1.text: Question eight. A route to ten dot one dot five dot zero slash twenty-four and one to ten dot one dot zero dot zero slash sixteen both match. Which wins? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: The slash twenty-four, the longest prefix. The longest prefix match is chosen first.

1.title: Practice Question 9
1.text: Question nine. Which attack fills a switch's M A C table so it floods frames out every port? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: M A C flooding. M A C flooding exhausts the table.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What is the passing score? Answer: seven hundred twenty on a scale of one hundred to nine hundred. Question two. What is the troubleshooting order? Answer: Identify, theory, test, plan, implement, verify, document. Question three. What are the five domains? Answer: Concepts, implementation, operations, security and troubleshooting.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What does R A D I U S authenticate? Answer: Network access for users and devices. Question five. Which port does H T T P S use? Answer: four hundred forty-three. Question six. What does V L A N hopping bypass? Answer: Network segmentation.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Exam: up to ninety questions, ninety minutes, seven hundred twenty of nine hundred, performance-based questions are scored. Weights: concepts twenty-three, implementation twenty, operations nineteen, security fourteen, troubleshooting twenty-four. Method: find the layer, match symptom to tool or fix, answer everything. Order: identify, theory, test, plan, implement, verify, document. If this course is helping you, please subscribe to the channel and hit the bell icon, so you get a notification when the next video is out. That completes the course. Good luck with the exam.
